waygate.waygateHQLeftPara1: Em sua longa história, a Waygate Technologies combina mais de 125 anos de experiência e um DNA global com a precisão imbatível da engenharia alemã. Sediada na Alemanha, a Waygate Technologies faz parte do segmento de Tecnologia Industrial e Energética (IET) da Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR).
waygate.waygateHQLeftPara2: We offer more premium non-destructive testing solutions than any other NDT brand — from safer X-ray, to advanced digital, to ultra-precise computed tomography, radiographic testing to HD remote visual inspection and ultrasonic portables.
waygate.waygateHQRightpara1: Atualmente, centenas de parceiros industriais em todo o mundo confiam nas nossas soluções de inspeção industrial e no nosso conhecimento para aumentar a confiabilidade e a produtividade. We're helping customers drive their digital transformation by applying state-of-the-art data and analytics to reveal groundbreaking insights and solve business challenges. Sua tranquilidade começa aqui.

brand.waygateDesc: World’s largest provider of non-destructive testing solutions including radiography, computed tomography (CT), remote visual inspection, and ultrasound.
brand.druckDesc: Os sensores de pressão piezo-resistivos da Druck e os instrumentos de teste e calibração fornecem aos nossos clientes o mais alto desempenho, estabilidade, qualidade, precisão e resposta mais rápida em qualquer ambiente.
brand.bentlyDesc: At Cordant, the Bently Nevada line of intelligent and connected devices, industrial sensors and transducer instrumentation protects machine assets plantwide.  With over 10 million sensors installed worldwide and seven decades of experience, Cordant's Bently Nevada line is renowned for monitoring the health of customers’ equipment in order to help reduce maintenance costs and prevent unplanned downtime and machine failure.
brand.panametricsDesc: A Panametrics é pioneira na indústria de tecnologia de sensores há mais de 50 anos. With an innovative culture, Panametrics continues to develop solutions for moisture, oxygen, liquid flow, and gas flow measurement.
brand.reuterStokesDesc: Our solutions include precise radiation measurement, nuclear reactor monitoring, UV flame detection, and downhole sensing for directional drilling.
